messages.subject: Project Onyx - completed; executed SSA attached
messages.plaintextBody:
Helena, Rohan, Nadia,

I'm pleased to confirm Project Onyx completed this afternoon. The £24m subscription monies have been received and the Series B shares allotted. Attached is the executed Subscription and Shareholders' Agreement; the executed Articles, IRA and board minutes will follow in the completion bible next week. We'll make the Companies House filings within the statutory deadline and update your statutory registers. Congratulations again.

James Osei | Whitfield Carter LLP

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ | www.whitfieldcarter.com
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
